name: Zapier
summary: Automation platform that connects web apps.

flows.title: Create a Zap and set up its trigger
steps: In the left sidebar of your account home, click + Create. A dropdown menu will appear.
Select Zap workflows. You will be redirected to the Zap editor in a new browser tab or window.
In the Zap editor, select the Trigger step. A dialog box will open.
In the search box, search for and select the app that will trigger the Zap. The right sidebar will open to the Setup tab.
Click the Trigger event field to open the dropdown menu, then select the event that you want to trigger the Zap.
Click the Account field and select an existing account from the list.
Select the Configure tab and set up all required fields and any optional fields that you need. Required fields have an asterisk after the field name.
Click the Test tab, then click Test trigger to load a test record from your app.
Review and select a record, then click Continue with selected record to complete the step.

flows.title: Add an action to a Zap
steps: In the Zap editor, select the Action step. A dialog box will open.
In the search box, search for and select the app that will perform the action in your Zap. The right sidebar will open to the Setup tab.
Click the Action event field to open the dropdown menu, then select the event that you want the Zap to perform.
Click the Account field and select an existing account from the list.
Configure the action's fields on the Configure tab.
